//: Lighthouse CI budget for the landing site — DESKTOP run. Its mobile twin is lighthouserc.mobile.json; both are executed by the landing-perf job in ci.yml against a production `vite preview` build. The two files MUST agree on `url` and `assert` — lighthouserc.spec.ts fails the build if they drift, so edit them together. The only intended difference is the form factor: this one pins `preset: desktop`, the mobile file omits it (Lighthouse emulates a mid-tier phone by default). Core Web Vitals (LCP < 2.5s, CLS < 0.1) and accessibility are hard assertions; performance score/TBT/FCP are advisory. Complements the payload budget in scripts/check-bundle-budget.ts, which asserts the bytes that produce these timings.
